label: title
js: game.hold(true); game.calm(); game.step(1); JSON.stringify({ touch: document.body.classList.contains('touch'), scroll: document.getElementById('title').scrollHeight > innerHeight + 2 })

label: 1P play
js: (() => { game.start({ level: 'easy', go: true, players: 1 }); game.step(1); return JSON.stringify(window.layoutCheck()); })()

label: 2P play
js: (() => { game.start({ level: 'easy', go: true, players: 2 }); game.step(1); return JSON.stringify(window.layoutCheck()); })()

label: results
js: (() => { const w = game.world(); w.lives = 1; w.water = 5; game.step(3); return JSON.stringify({ screen: game.state().screen, scroll: document.getElementById('results').scrollHeight > innerHeight + 2 }); })()
